summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of primary sclerosing cholangitis and cirrhosis was admitted for right upper quadrant abdominal pain and low-grade fever, concerning for recurrent cholangitis. She was started on IV meropenem in the emergency department and continued on antibiotics during her hospitalization. She remained afebrile, and her liver enzymes improved. A PICC line was placed on discharge to complete a 14-day course of ertapenem at home. Her home diuretics were held during admission due to infection and were to be restarted after discharge. She was discharged home with home health services and instructions to follow up with the liver clinic for PICC removal and ongoing management.
